# Controlled1row API probe, chỉ thay dependency trong venv riêng; không model/data thật.
import time
probe_start=time.perf_counter()
DUCK_ROOT=Path('/content')/('kltn-duckdb-api-'+uuid.uuid4().hex)
DUCK_ROOT.mkdir()
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','venv','--without-pip','--system-site-packages',str(DUCK_ROOT/'.venv')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
assert result.returncode==0,(result.stdout,result.stderr)
DUCK_PY=str(DUCK_ROOT/'.venv/bin/python')
query_code = "import duckdb,json,sys; from pathlib import Path; assert Path(sys.prefix).resolve()==Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve() and sys.prefix!=sys.base_prefix; p=Path(sys.argv[1]); c=duckdb.connect(); result={'version':duckdb.__version__};\ntry:\n c.execute('COPY (SELECT 1::BIGINT AS source_row, 1::INTEGER AS correct) TO ? (FORMAT PARQUET)',[str(p)]); rows=c.execute('SELECT * FROM read_parquet(?)',[str(p)]).fetchall(); assert rows==[(1,1)]; result.update(status='PASS',rows=rows)\nexcept Exception as error:result.update(status='ERROR',error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error))\nfinally:c.close()\nprint(json.dumps(result))"
reports=[]
for phase in ('before','after'):
 if phase=='after':
  command=[DUCK_PY,'-m','pip','install','--only-binary=:all:','--report',str(DUCK_ROOT/'install-report.json'),'duckdb==1.5.6']
  with (DUCK_ROOT/'install.log').open('xb') as log:
   installed=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=300)
  installed.check_returncode()
 completed=subprocess.run([DUCK_PY,'-c',query_code,str(DUCK_ROOT/(phase+'.parquet')),str(DUCK_ROOT/'.venv')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 completed.check_returncode(); reports.append(json.loads(completed.stdout))
assert reports[0]['status']=='ERROR' and reports[0]['version']=='1.3.2',reports
assert reports[1]['status']=='PASS' and reports[1]['version']=='1.5.6',reports
install_report=json.loads((DUCK_ROOT/'install-report.json').read_text())
wheel=next(x for x in install_report['install'] if x['metadata']['name'].lower()=='duckdb')
assert wheel['download_info']['archive_info']['hashes']['sha256']=='644f54ce99b3b61844bc9a3fe80e0aecb1ea4084b1fffc4396d1569db6111679'
report={'status':'DUCKDB_API_VERSION_CONTRAST_PASS','before':reports[0],'after':reports[1],
 'wheel_sha256':wheel['download_info']['archive_info']['hashes']['sha256'],'venv_prefix_verified':True,
 'workspace':str(DUCK_ROOT),'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-probe_start,'scope':'SamePython/runtime/source1row COPY probe; onlyDuckDBversion changes in isolatedvenv; noGPUmodel/globalinstall/realdata'}
(DUCK_ROOT/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
